rbz03nav.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! pqrqmbnf.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Gold Tinsel
pqrqmbnf.sourceDescription: Make a real statement this Christmas with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Gold Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and visual impact than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The luxurious metallic gold finish catches and reflects the surrounding light beautifully, creating the unmistakable sparkle of traditional Christmas tinsel. Its mixture of reflective strands creates a rich, full appearance that stands out particularly well against green Christmas foliage. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows you to decorate multiple areas without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick gold tinsel provides plenty of length, coverage and festive sparkle to create an impressive traditional Christmas display.
